triggerOptimizer.presetHint: Current "{{preset}}": candidates per ability {{candidateLimit}}, max search rounds {{maxRounds}}, rounds {{rounds}}. Changing an advanced value switches to Custom.
triggerOptimizer.roundsHint: Slots with a large candidate pool are screened first at 2 rounds on an independent seed set, and only the most promising few candidates go on to full-length sampling — rows marked "Screened" in the candidate table carry only 2 samples. Each full evaluation runs this many samples and averages them; the baseline and every candidate share the same seed set (common random numbers), so comparisons are paired differences instead of luck. Rounds is the first knob for a usable conclusion: the noise floor (adoption gate, 2×SE) scales with 1/sqrt(rounds), and the p<0.05 significance threshold (decision rule, t×SE) additionally carries t(rounds-1) (12.7 at 2 rounds, which cannot resolve anything below ~10%). Switching presets or changing the duration re-derives it automatically.
triggerOptimizer.advanced: Advanced (max search rounds / candidates per ability)
triggerOptimizer.weightsHint: Death safety is computed as 100% - profit - XP. More deaths are penalized; fewer deaths are rewarded (symmetric).
triggerOptimizer.searchHint: Each round optimizes the ability slots one by one and stops early when a round brings no improvement. More candidates take longer.
triggerOptimizer.simulationHoursHint: Simulation length used by the search; independent from the Home simulation duration.
triggerOptimizer.scopeHint: Only equipped ability triggers are optimized. Use the Food Optimizer for food and drinks.

triggerOptimizer.partyHint: Leave empty for the current solo simulation. Ticking teammates evaluates the whole party (closer to how you actually farm), but each simulation runs roughly 3-4x slower. Teammates join with gear / abilities / triggers frozen - only the main character's triggers are changed, and metrics stay attributed to the main character.
triggerOptimizer.pairingHint: The baseline and every candidate use the same seed set (common random numbers), so reported differences are paired differences with most of the random noise removed - and results are reproducible.
triggerOptimizer.resourcesUnavailable: Could not read the character's max HP/MP, so candidates needing numeric thresholds were skipped (fewer combined candidates).
triggerOptimizer.verifyUnconfirmed: Not confirmed: the improvement did not reach significance on independent samples; append another verification for more certainty
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendMissing: The report is missing verification samples, so no further verification can be appended

triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendPlanBudget: Cost guard (single append <= {{singlePercent}}% · cumulative <= {{percent}}% of the whole run): this append adds only {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{simulations}} runs)
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendCumulative: {{spent}} / {{budget}} appended runs so far (incl. this append)
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendArchiveWithinLimits: Appended {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{mergedRounds}} rounds merged); within the {{cap}}-round cap and cost guard
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendArchiveCapped: Appended {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{mergedRounds}} rounds merged); {{cap}}-round cap reached

triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendExhausted: Nothing more to append: the reverse-solved rounds exceed the {{cap}}-round cap, so extra samples would still not decide; lengthen the simulation or switch to the fine preset
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendBudgetExhausted: Nothing more to append: the cumulative cost guard (<= {{percent}}% of the whole run) leaves no budget
triggerOptimizer.verifyAppendDecisive: The verification verdict is already decisive, so no further append is needed
triggerOptimizer.verificationHint: Re-runs 'current setup vs best setup' under a different seed set (6 paired rounds) to check whether the improvement holds.
triggerOptimizer.scoreScaleHint: Score scale -1 to +1: 0 matches the baseline, +1 is roughly double the baseline (log-compressed, so gains near the top are progressively harder); negative means worse overall.
triggerOptimizer.verificationMissing: This search did not run an independent verification; the conclusion comes only from the paired comparison during the search.

verdictHeadlines.inconclusive: Gain is not significant - proceed with caution

triggerOptimizer.noImprovement: No trigger setup beat the current one; keep your current configuration.
triggerOptimizer.evidenceBlocked: A candidate scored higher than the current setup, but the paired round-by-round evidence was too weak (the difference did not clear the noise floor, or rounds were too few to estimate noise), so the adoption gate rejected it. To confirm, raise Rounds or re-run with the Fine preset - the noise floor (adoption gate) shown in the conclusion card drops as rounds grow; use it to judge whether another run is worth it (more rounds resolve smaller improvements, at a proportional runtime cost); the p<0.05 significance bar is stricter - see the significance threshold (decision rule) in the conclusion card.
triggerOptimizer.deepDiveNote: Blocked candidates were automatically re-checked on an independent seed set ({{count}} x {{rounds}} rounds; the screening samples are not reused for the verdict): {{passed}} passed and were adopted, {{blocked}} still lacked evidence.
triggerOptimizer.adoptionEvidenceHint: Adoption basis: paired delta {{mean}} ± {{se}} exceeds the noise floor 2×SE = {{threshold}} (evidence above noise, not a significance claim); verification p = {{p}}.
triggerOptimizer.roundLimitReached: The search used its full round budget and the last round still adopted a candidate - the fixed point was not reached, so more improvement may be available. Raise the max search rounds or re-run with the Fine preset.
triggerOptimizer.scopeText: {{zone}} - difficulty {{tier}} - {{hours}} hours: triggers are a global skill setup, and the search only evaluated the target above, so the conclusion may not hold at another difficulty or zone.
triggerOptimizer.partyScopeSingle: Simulation loadout: solo (only the main character's triggers are changed; metrics are attributed to the main character).
triggerOptimizer.partyScopeText: Simulation loadout: party {{party}} (only the main character's triggers are changed; metrics are attributed to the main character).
triggerOptimizer.partyDetectionNote: Under a party loadout the judge chain's true-detection rate is measurably lower (local benchmark 93.2% → 64.6% on the same seeds and split), so the search may under-adopt; consider raising Rounds and re-running.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessRunning: Re-checking difficulty {{tier}}: {{simulations}} simulations (2 setups x {{rounds}} rounds), {{seconds}} s elapsed.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessHint: Re-runs the simulated best setup against the search-start setup at the neighbouring difficulty, paired over {{rounds}} rounds on a fresh seed set ({{simulations}} simulations in total) - if the gain holds there, it is not specific to the original difficulty; if not, this optimization only applies within a narrow range.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessPlanRounds: Reverse-solved from the report's verification evidence: {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{simulations}} simulations); baseline {{base}} rounds, cap {{cap}} rounds.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessPlanCapped: The reverse-solved round count exceeds the robustness cap: runs the full {{cap}} rounds/side ({{simulations}} simulations).
triggerOptimizer.robustnessPlanBudget: Limited by the {{percent}}% of a full run cost guard: {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{simulations}} simulations), cap {{cap}} rounds.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessUnavailable: This target has no neighbouring difficulty to re-check on.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessMissingBaseline: This report was produced by an older version (no search-start setup recorded) - run the search again to enable the re-check.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendHint: Appends a fresh seed set: {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{simulations}} runs), merged with the {{currentRounds}} rounds already checked (cap {{cap}} rounds) - the verdict may firm up or be overturned.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendCumulative: {{spent}} / {{budget}} appended runs so far (incl. this append)
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendMissing: The report is missing robustness samples, so the re-check cannot be appended; run the search again first.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendZeroDiff: The paired per-round differences are exactly zero: more samples still cannot decide, so none are spent.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendAtCap: The {{cap}}-round re-check cap is already reached, so nothing can be appended (the cap is a total limit).
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendBudgetExhausted: The cost guard (single <= {{singlePercent}}% · cumulative <= {{percent}}% of a whole run) leaves no room, so none are spent.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendExhausted: The append plan has no usable rounds, so none are spent.
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendArchiveWithinLimits: Appended {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{mergedRounds}} rounds merged); within the {{cap}}-round cap and cost guard
triggerOptimizer.robustnessAppendArchiveBudget: Appended {{rounds}} rounds/side ({{mergedRounds}} rounds merged); cost guard engaged (single <= {{singlePercent}}% · cumulative <= {{percent}}%; {{cap}}-round cap)
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloor: This run ({{rounds}} rounds x {{hours}} h): noise floor (adoption gate, 2×SE) about +/-{{noiseFloor}} points (about {{profitPercent}}% profit); significance threshold (p<0.05 decision rule, t×SE) about +/-{{significanceFloor}} points. Improvements below the noise floor cannot be told apart from noise (not adoptable); improvements below the significance threshold, even if adopted, cannot be judged p<0.05 in this run.
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceRounds: To get an improvement of about +{{target}} points (about {{targetProfit}}% profit, the adoption-gate scale) adopted (past the noise floor: above noise, not a significance claim), raise Rounds to about {{rounds}}: the noise floor (adoption gate) then drops to about +/-{{noiseFloor}} points (about {{profitPercent}}% profit) and the significance threshold (decision rule) to about +/-{{significanceFloor}} points. {{significance}}Wall-clock scales with the number of rounds.
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceSatisfied: This run's noise floor (adoption gate, +/-{{noiseFloor}} points) is already below the adoption-gate scale (+{{target}} points, about {{targetProfit}}% profit): improvements of that size get adopted (above noise, not a significance claim). {{significance}}
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceCapped: Even at the {{rounds}}-round cap the noise floor (adoption gate) stays about +/-{{noiseFloor}} points (about {{profitPercent}}% profit), above the adoption-gate scale of +{{target}} points, so at {{hours}} hours an improvement of that size cannot be told apart from noise (not adoptable). {{significance}}Lengthening the simulation (noise scales as 1/sqrt(rounds x hours)) pays off more than adding rounds.
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceSignificanceRounds: Judging it a decisive p<0.05 conclusion needs about {{rounds}} rounds.
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceSignificanceAtCurren: At the current number of rounds an improvement of that size is already enough for a decisive p<0.05 conclusion.
triggerOptimizer.detectionFloorAdviceSignificanceCapped: A decisive p<0.05 conclusion is out of reach within the {{cap}}-round cap - significance is decided by verification / appended verification instead.
triggerOptimizer.jointAdoptionNote: Cross-slot joint adoption: {{count}} skill pair(s) passed the evidence gate as joint configurations compared against the round start, adding {{slots}} skill(s) - a rescue for pairs whose per-slot evidence was too weak.
triggerOptimizer.metricSourceSearch: Metric source: search-time estimate (baseline and candidates share one seed set, sampled subset)
triggerOptimizer.metricSourceVerification: Metric source: verification run (6 paired rounds under a different seed set)
triggerOptimizer.candidatesTruncated: {{count}} more candidates were cut off by the per-slot candidate limit ({{limit}}) and were never evaluated - raising that limit would evaluate them too.
triggerOptimizer.candidateMetricsHint: Source: search-time paired estimate - 'Best' is the overall config measured when this slot's candidate was adopted (skills adopted earlier included), compared against the search-start baseline on the same seed set; the change is cumulative, not this slot's isolated effect.
triggerOptimizer.netMetricsHint: Source: per-metric paired deltas of this slot's adopted change against the slot's search start, on the same seed set - changes adopted for other abilities in the same round are not included. Significance only answers whether the change exceeds noise; the direction comes from the sign (a drop in deaths is negative). The table below shows the cumulative baseline to best view.
triggerOptimizer.detailsHint: Open the {{count}} candidate results and metric details
triggerOptimizer.evidenceBudgetNoBudget: {{label}}: {{spent}} runs spent (the whole-run count was not recorded, so the budget is unavailable)
triggerOptimizer.evidenceBudgetStopZeroDiff: the per-round differences are exactly zero, so more samples still cannot decide
triggerOptimizer.evidenceBudgetStopBudget: the cost guard (single <= {{singlePercent}}% · cumulative <= {{percent}}%) leaves no room

multiRound.upgradedEphHint: Mean encounters per hour across this variant's rounds (kills/h), i.e. the upgraded EPH.
multiRound.scoreModelValue: Performance/Stability/Cost weighted by configured settings (quantile mapped to 5-95, with confidence penalty)
multiRound.scoreModelParamPerformance: Performance: DPS, No RNG Profit/day, XP/h and Kills/h gains are rank-mapped within the batch to 5-95, then combined using the current queue subweights. Higher is better.
multiRound.scoreModelParamPerformanceSubweights: Current performance subweights: Profit {{profit}}% / XP {{xp}}% / DPS {{dps}}% / Kills {{kills}}%.
multiRound.scoreModelParamStability: Stability: the average CV across the four metrics is rank-mapped within the batch to 5-95. Lower volatility scores higher.
multiRound.scoreModelParamCost: Cost: upgrade cost, purchase time, and the selected gold per 0.01% metric are each mapped to 5-95 (cost metrics use log scaling first). Lower cost scores higher.
multiRound.scoreModelParamGoldPerPointValidity: Strict gold per 0.01% is shown only when the final robust deltas for DPS, No RNG Profit/day, XP/h and Kills/h are all positive. Otherwise it is marked N/A.
multiRound.scoreModelParamCompositeGoldPerPoint: Composite gold per 0.01% uses the same current performance subweights (Profit {{profit}}% / XP {{xp}}% / DPS {{dps}}% / Kills {{kills}}%). It is shown when that weighted composite delta is positive, and can be selected for Cost Score in Settings.
multiRound.scoreModelParamRobustWinsorize: Robust stats - winsorize: applies two-sided {{winsorPct}}% winsorization per metric to suppress outlier rounds.
multiRound.scoreModelParamRobustMedianBlend: Robust stats - median blend: robust delta = winsorized mean {{meanWeight}}% + median {{medianWeight}}%.
multiRound.scoreModelParamRobustConfidencePenalty: Robust stats - confidence penalty: confidence is estimated from sample size and 95% CI width, then final score = base score × ({{baseWeight}}% + {{penaltyWeight}}% × confidence).
multiRound.scoreInvalidZeroLegend: * means this score is forced to 0 due to invalid data (missing/NaN/non-computable), not a normal last-place score.

advisor.title: Farm Advisor
advisor.desc: Use your current team, buffs, achievements, housing, pricing, and run duration to rank the best farming targets across solo zones and group zones.
advisor.scoreExplainTitle: How the Composite Score and Confidence are computed
advisor.scoreExplainCompositeHeading: How is the composite score computed?
advisor.scoreExplainComposite1: Each target is rated on 3 metrics: Daily Profit, XP/h, and Safety (derived from Deaths/h). Kills/h is shown for reference only and does not affect the composite score.
advisor.scoreExplainComposite2: Each metric is compared against all candidates to produce a 0–100 relative score.
advisor.scoreExplainComposite3: Scores are weighted by your chosen goal preset (Balanced / Profit / XP / Safe / Custom) into a base score.
advisor.scoreExplainConfidence1: Reflects how consistent results are across multiple scans — the closer the per-run data, the higher confidence.
advisor.scoreExplainConfidence2: Sample size: more rounds → higher confidence (10–20 refine rounds approaches the ceiling).
advisor.scoreExplainConfidence3: Run-to-run variance: the smaller the variance in profit / XP / deaths across rounds, the higher confidence.
advisor.scoreExplainConfidence4: The penalty for low confidence is small (~15%); even at 0% confidence the final score still preserves 85% of the base score.

skilling.title: Skilling Upgrade Planner
skilling.costModeDescription: Prioritizes the plan with the lowest net cost per experience.
skilling.balancedModeDescription: Uses the planner's lowest-net-cost-per-XP full-level route for the current level as the baseline, then compares its full-level candidates. It prefers a shorter candidate only when its net cost per XP is no greater than baseline + {{percent}}% of |baseline|.
skilling.balancedCostToleranceHint: Controls how much higher the current level's net cost per XP may be than its lowest-cost baseline. A higher value allows faster but more expensive routes.
skilling.balancedCostToleranceChanged: The existing result used {{resultPercent}}%; the current {{currentPercent}}% setting takes effect after recalculation.
skilling.speedModeDescription: Prioritizes the shortest estimated time for the current level.
skilling.optimizationModeCommonRules: All three modes calculate and show costs. Plans without required ask prices remain unavailable, and the route is recalculated after every level using the latest inventory, drinks, and Buff state.
